answer: The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce. A lagoon of per-task receipts records who did what, and the garden of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it. Written in a cause and effect, two sentences register, it stays short. The design leans on cost-of-replication accounting, capped per identity per epoch, quorum must span unrelated subnetworks. The pulse of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy.
